Players Committee card image of [[Jabba The Hutt (V) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “While with your alien leader, Jabba is immune to attrition and may not be targeted by Interrupts or weapons. May deploy one Scum And Villainy from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During battle, may use 1 Force to double the power of one other non-[Maintenance] alien present.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/jabbathehutt.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 ab74419] (31 July 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
